name: Private Investor (PI) Visa and Investment-Based Permanent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a recommendation from BIDA (Bangladesh Investment Development Authority) or BEZA (Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority).
Non-repatriable investment of at least US$75,000 in Bangladesh.
requirements.fix_path: Invest and retain (non-repatriably) at least US$75,000 in Bangladesh.

evidence_required.document: Investment proof (bank transfer records, company equity documentation)

outcome.duration_length: PI Visa: initially 1-2 years; Permanent Resident Permit: indefinite, issued as a visa sticker/stamp, valid for as long as the qualifying investment is maintained

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Bangladesh (Embassy of Bangladesh, Moscow) -- Investment Opportunities in Bangladesh: Private Investor (PI) visa requires BIDA or BEZA recommendation
Consulate General of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Dubai -- Investment Prospects in Bangladesh: 'Permanent resident permits on investing US$75,000 (non-repatriable)'

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both sources tier-1 official diplomatic missions. FIGURE CONFLICT, DISCLOSED RATHER THAN PICKED-A-SIDE: this file uses the US$75,000 PR threshold as it currently appears on an official Bangladesh consulate page (bcgdubai.gov.bd). Multiple tier-3 sources (law-firm summaries, investment-migration press) report a HIGHER, more recently-updated figure of US$200,000 for PR, citing 'Industrial Policy 2022' / 'BIDA Policy 2023' -- and separately, a 2016 press report (The Daily Star, tier-4) describes a cabinet decision that year doubling PR-adjacent thresholds from US$75,000 to US$150,000 for a related temporary-residence category (figures for that specific category do not cleanly map onto this file's PR track). None of the higher figures were independently confirmed at tier-1 in this build -- it is plausible the consulate page is simply stale and has not been updated since a subsequent policy revision, but this dataset does not upgrade a hard requirement's figure based on unconfirmed tier-3 reporting. Treat US$75,000 as the last tier-1-confirmed figure, and treat US$200,000 as a plausible but unconfirmed current figure worth direct BIDA verification before relying on either number. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the general 5-year PR-to-naturalisation track described in tier-3 sourcing (see bd_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not independently confirmed at tier-1 here.
